top_choice_rationale: P002 credits a prediction of flat bands at a magic twist angle (Bistritzer and MacDonald) and the experimental discovery of correlated insulating and superconducting phases there (Jarillo-Herrero), reproduced by many laboratories. It opens a tunable platform in which twist and stacking geometry control electronic phases, which I judge the more important physics. The citation rests on the prediction and the observed phases, not the unsettled pairing mechanism. The cost is a three-name limit that omits Cao, Fatemi and the hBN moire groups, and a shorter maturity record than P001. P001 (Katori and Ye) has the cleanest allocation and independently confirmed 1e-18 uncertainties, and I rank it a close second without reservation; award is preferable to no award.
recusal_note: No documented personal or institutional relationship with any credited person in P001 or P002. Chalmers ties include committee member Goran Johansson, and long-running academic exchanges in Japan, where Katori works; none seems to require recusal.
